verdict.rationale: Gmail's own docs say Gemini in Gmail can draft new emails and refine drafts for tone, and that suggested replies let users reply in one click, in your voice. That covers the core of the story. However, the 'your voice' claim is a single marketing line tied to one-click suggested replies. Nothing documents how Gemini learns or applies a user's personal writing style in full drafted replies, and there is no hands-on or community corroboration. missing for 10: documented mechanism for personalizing full reply drafts to the user's own voice and tone (beyond generic tone refinement), explicit review-before-send drafting workflow for replies, independent or hands-on corroboration that drafts avoid generic boilerplate.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI drafts replies in my own voice and tone — ready to review and send, not generic boilerplate

citations.quote: Gemini in Gmail saves you time drafting or polishing emails, and suggested replies help you reply in one click, in your voice.
Draft: Create new emails or refine existing drafts for tone and clarity.
